title: Trust and emotional safety
header_line: My analysis of one book on neuro-linguistic programming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What makes people feel safe with you?
I said that trust is a big part of leadership, and that as a leader you want to create a trust pattern. I said that safety is saying: I will make sure that you are very successful no matter what.
I said that my emotional safety is always intact, whatever the circumstances, even in a hostile environment.
A student said that in their company they set a goal and made it the success or failure line, even though they made it up in their heads.
I said that the trick is creating patterns where you are not stuck in winning or losing, so that you break the pattern of we failed.

I said that after every meeting people say what a fun and pleasant person that was, and I have a pattern of creating and controlling my communication that is always consistent. This is my own account.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the sentence that says people are safe with you.
Write the line you drew for success and failure.
Write how you break a win or lose pattern.
Write what stays intact in you under pressure.

check.q: What did I say is a big part of leadership?
What did I say I am not stuck in?
What did a student say about a success line?
choices: They made it up in their heads
It was set by a bank

recap: Create trust. Keep your own safety. Break win-or-lose.
